root.claim: A single deterministic fixed-tape Turing machine multiplies two $n$-bit integers exactly in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time with $\kappa=2^{-182}$, using fast address interchange and fast simultaneous butterfly layers inside a Gaussian-resampling, chirp and synthetic-transform reduction.
root.method: Reduce the product to a convolution evaluated through Gaussian-resampled, chirped synthetic transforms, make the two costly tape operations (address movement and butterfly layers) cheaper by a power of the logarithm using networks with a rank saving, and then assemble the algorithm and add up its costs.

motivation.text: Scanning $\Theta(n)$ bits at each of $\Theta(\log n)$ transform levels already costs $\Theta(n\log n)$, so beating $n\log n$ requires cheaper address movement and cheaper arithmetic.

quote.quote: We therefore need savings in both movement and arithmetic.

adds.name: logical volume
adds.meaning: The number of stored data bits of the array being processed.

adds.name: wire count
adds.meaning: The number of wires, including scratch wires, in a fixed linear network.

adds.name: label dimension
adds.meaning: The dimension of the space whose subspaces label the network, and the factor by which a call's parameter is divided.

adds.name: total edge rank
adds.meaning: The sum of the ranks (dimension changes) over all edges of the network, equal to the number of smaller calls.

adds.name: call parameter
adds.meaning: The number of field digits or selected axes handled by one call, a power of $m$.

adds.name: interchange exponent
adds.meaning: A fixed exponent below one with $s/W<m^{\tau}$, giving the cost $O(Vu^{\tau})$ of address interchange.

adds.name: layer exponent
adds.meaning: A fixed exponent below one giving the cost $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ of a simultaneous butterfly layer.

adds.name: saving exponent
adds.meaning: The power saving $2^{-182}$ in the final bound $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$.

adds.name: precision
adds.meaning: The number of fractional bits of each stored complex coordinate.

adds.name: axis count
adds.meaning: The number of axes of the transform array, polynomially small in $p$.

adds.name: chunk width
adds.meaning: The number of bits in each address chunk of an axis, with $K=\lfloor d^c\rfloor$.

adds.name: record length
adds.meaning: The power-of-two number of complex coefficients in each polynomial record modulo $y^r+1$.

adds.name: record log-length
adds.meaning: The binary logarithm of $r$.

adds.name: box size
adds.meaning: The number of polynomial coefficients in the padded power-of-two box, with $Tp=\Theta(n)$.

adds.name: source length
adds.meaning: The prime length of the $i$th cyclic axis of the source tensor.

adds.name: padded length
adds.meaning: The power-of-two length $r/2$ or $r$ of the $i$th axis of the padded box.

adds.name: source size
adds.meaning: The product of the source lengths $s_i$, the length of the cyclic convolution.

adds.name: Gaussian width
adds.meaning: A parameter controlling the width of the Gaussian weights used in resampling.

adds.name: axis exponent
adds.meaning: The exponent $2^{-75}$ with $d=\lfloor b^{\epsilon}\rfloor$.

adds.name: chunk exponent
adds.meaning: The exponent $2^{-56}$ with $K=\lfloor d^{c}\rfloor$.

adds.name: normalized cost
adds.meaning: The time of a call of parameter $m^k$ divided by its logical volume.
